about_the_game:
Welcome to "Rinny Platformer Rage Game"! A game inspired by a completely different series "Pretty Blood" with a completely different tone from this trash. (NOTE: WE'RE NO LONGER AFFILIATED TO PB IN ANY CANON FORM, THIS ONLY USES ITS CHARACTERS NOW, consider them "ours" if you want, they aren't at all but sure you do you) Make friends (dont)! Explore (not much)! Die (90% of the gameplay)! Again and again! Laugh a lot! All jokes in this game are satire and should not be taken seriously. So stop reading and play! In any case, this game is divided into several sections and the development is also divided into those sections. Please be patient!

Rinny, a heartless psychopath with no care for anyone but herself, has been reduced to nothing more than a brain-damaged idiot! of course, life isn't gonna be easy, a tower has appeared on her home town with a mysterious robot that appeared and kidnapped all of her town into it, rinny, having nowhere to go, decides to enter the tower, not knowing that it was a trap to neutralize her. It's her mission to cure her brain damage and take the tower down, but... even if she does so, it seems like there'll be more than what just caught her eye in the moment. Use your keyboard carefully to break Rinny's jumps, if your jumps are too long, she'll fall over which could give enemies potential time to eliminate you! avoid traps, enemies, and figure out puzzles in any way you and that head of yours can! you encounter an enemy outside of a level? well, to a battle that goes! avoid the bullets, ACT to peacefully finish a fight or FIGHT to brawl your way out! buy items, sort your inventory between allies, and get to this story's climax that'll build up through all 4 sections! the playtime can depend on which path you take, how much time you want to take, and how much you're willing to take on this game! feel free, section 1's demo lasts about 2 hours while section 0 can variate to 20-30 minutes. But in this platformer-RPG where many genres are mixed in, you don't know what to expect! Let this game's soundtrack blow your ears to smithereens from how much it SUCKS! haha... seriously though, don't expect much soundtrack wise.

Fill yourself with the multiple gamemodes of the game! including

For section 0:

  • Story mode

  • Local Competitive

  • Local Coop

For section 1:

  • Hard Mode (story mode)

  • Harder Mode (tougher enemies, weaker allies)

  • Nutslock (if an ally gets downed they're gone forever, and if you lose all your allies you start over)

  • Lesbian Mode (Freeplay)

  • Bluray Mode 

  • Elma Mode (every enemy is replaced with Elma)

NOTE: EVERY GAMEMODE IS UNLOCKED UPON BEATING ITS SECTION'S STORY MODE

content_descriptors.notes: There's a secret route in the game which allows players to actually kill enemies, which covers them in blood and in certain scenes their organs may spill out, specially if its a cutscene, clear depiction of cigarettes in section 0 by Nebo, both in his meeting cutscene and in his victory pose on local competitive, it is to note that in the game's settings blood and organs CAN be disabled
